Rectification

2. The Audit Act 1957 (Act 62] is rectified in the English language text in
subparagraph 1(1) of the First Schedule by substituting for the words "five
thousand seven hundred and forty five ringgit and sixty sen" the words "eight
thousand six hundred and seventy ringgit".

Made 2 October 2000.

AKTA PENYEMAKAN UNDANG-UNDANG 1968

PERINTAH PENYEMAKAN UNDANG-UNDANG (PEMBETULAN
AKTA TATACARA KEWANGAN 1957) 2000

PaDA menjalankan kuasa yang diberikan oleh seksyen 15 Akta Penyemakan

Undang-Undang 1968 (Akta I], Pesuruhjaya Penyemak Undang-Undang membuat
perintah yang berikut:

Nama dan permulaan kuat kuasa

1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Penyemakan Undang-Undang
(Pembetulan Akta Tatacara Kewangan 1957) 2000.

(2) Perintah ini hendaklah disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 31 Ogos
Pembetulan
2. Akta Tatacara Kewangan 1957 (Akta 61] dibetulkan dalam teks bahasa
Inggeris dalam Jadual Kedua dengan memasukkan selepas butiran "Self-accounting
Departments Clearance Account." butiran yang berikut:

"Sinking Funds Account.".

Dibuat 5 Oktober 2000.
(P.N. (SU.2) 37/1; PN(PU?)2311

SALMAH BINTI ABDUL RAHMAN
Pesuruhjaya Penyemak Undang-Undang Malaysia

2711                       P.U. (A) 378-379.

REVISION OF LAWS ACT 1968

REVISION OF Laws (RECTIFICATION OF FINANCIAL PROCEDURE AcT 1957)
Order 2000

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 15 of the Revision of Laws Act
1968 [Act J], the Commissioner of Law Revision makes the following order:
Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Revision of Laws (Rectification of
Financial Procedure Act 1957) Order 2000.

(2) This Order shall be deemed to have come into operation on 31 August
Rectification
2. The Financial Procedure Act 1957 [Act 61] is rectified in the English
language text in the Second Schedule by inserting after item "Self-accounting
Departments Clearance Account." the following item:

"Sinking Funds Account.".

Made 5 October 2000.
[P.N. (SU.2) 37/1; PN(PU?)231]

SALMAH BINTI ABDUL RAHMAN
Commissioner of Law Revision Malaysia
